title: Code-Upgrade Contribution on Whole Water Service Line Replacement, Utility Line Protection Plans
content:
# Code-Upgrade Contribution on Whole Water Service Line Replacement

Code-compliance schedule, Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans. The galvanized steel amounts are sized from the living area on the household's Homeowner Service Contracts record.

## Rule

A water service line replaced whole is brought up to current code: a galvanized steel line is replaced in copper with a new curb stop, sized by the plumbing code to the home's water demand, so a larger home needs the next pipe size up; a line of any other material needs a new curb stop and tracer wire; Bridgewell sizes the upsizing from the living area on its own records, so a home with no living area on those records is upgraded at the standard galvanized size. Exterior material upgrade contribution: on a water service line that calls for whole-line work and whose service line material on record is galvanized steel, a home whose living area recorded on the household's active Bridgewell homeowner service contract for the same property address is at least the upsizing area in square feet adds the upsized galvanized upgrade contribution, and a home recorded below the upsizing area in square feet, or with no living area recorded on such a contract, adds the galvanized upgrade contribution; on a water service line that calls for whole-line work and whose recorded material is anything other than galvanized steel, the standard upgrade contribution is added; every other request adds no exterior material upgrade contribution. The exterior material upgrade contribution is paid on top of the occurrence cap, and only for permanent exterior work whose contractor quote is above the exterior permanent-work payment.

An exterior line calls for whole-line work when the plan replaces whole lines after repeat breaks, which is when its full replacement break count is above zero, and the most recent completed repair on the same line was completed no more than the plan's replacement lookback days before the request date.

## Plan figures that decide whole-line work

| Plan | Full-replacement break count | Replacement lookback |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | 0 | 0 days |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | 2 | 730 days |

## Contributions

| Line and whole-line work | Service line material on the plan record | Living area on an active Homeowner Service Contracts contract of the household at the same address | Contribution |
|---|---|---|---|
| water service line calling for whole-line work | galvanized steel | 2000 square feet or more (upsizing area: 2000) | $1050.00 (upsized galvanized) |
| water service line calling for whole-line work | galvanized steel | below 2000 square feet, or none recorded | $750.00 (galvanized) |
| water service line calling for whole-line work | any other material, including a material recorded as unknown | not read | $250.00 (standard) |
| any other request | any | not read | none |

## Boundary cases

- Living area recorded as exactly 2000 square feet on a galvanized line: $1050.00; 1999: $750.00.
- A homeowner service contract that is not active, or is for another address, records no living area for this purpose: $750.00 on a galvanized line.
- Most recent completed repair on the line 730 days before the request date: whole-line work; 731 days: not.
